edits.old: Then one record, one update, one event and one case-move answer exist and the repeat is returned and counted
edits.new:
Then one record, one update, one event and one case-move answer exist and the repeat is returned and counted

  Scenario: AC10 Activity retried or timed out (no legacy origin)
    Given an activity of WriteOffWorkflow calls rwb-case or rwb-decision and the call does not answer inside 2 s
    When the activity is retried
    Then the retry repeats the call on the workflow's own retry schedule and the record, the case move and the event are each written once

edits.old: | TC-E6-018-14 | AC9 | Component | The same request and the same Idempotency-Key sent twice; one record, one update, one event, one case-move answer and the repeat counted |
